title: Subject hold blocks owned discharge plan
diagnosis: Active ownership does not bypass unresolved patient-subject holds. The discharge medication and follow-up instructions exist in the source prefix, but the query receives an empty packet.

judge_spec.notes: Multi-slot discharge utility after successful TEE-guided cardioversion.

selected_source_turns.text: Procedure-day note: morning apixaban and metoprolol taken, lisinopril held, no NSAIDs, proceeding with TEE-guided cardioversion pending TEE findings.
TEE is complete. No left atrial appendage thrombus was seen, so we proceeded with synchronized cardioversion and restored sinus rhythm.
In recovery, your rhythm is sinus, heart rate is 68, and you are waking up appropriately.
That is good news. What is the medication plan from here?

Continue apixaban 5 milligrams twice daily without interruption for at least four weeks. Continue metoprolol tartrate 37.5 milligrams twice daily for now. Restart lisinopril 10 milligrams this evening. Finish magnesium oxide 400 milligrams nightly for three more nights. Continue omeprazole and avoid ibuprofen and other NSAIDs.
Correct. Monday, March 16 at 8:40 AM for the nurse callback, then Tuesday, March 17 with ECG at 11:00 AM and my visit at 11:30 AM in Suite 4C.
